# Why did my Wix product import fail or drop variants?

> Free Wix Stores product CSV checker: finds variants with no product row, choices that are not in the option list, product names over 80 characters, bad prices, TRUE/FALSE and inventory values, discounts over 100 percent, broken image links and Excel-damaged SKUs, with line numbers, and applies safe fixes.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
